sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: First identify an actually authorized copying procedure and the exact spell or scroll, legal source access, rank, language/notation, ability/tool requirements, facility and recipient record. Reduce only that actor's eligible copying active time to one half and mundane-material quantities to three quarters; rare inks and unique components are unchanged. NEW: apply the strongest eligible reduction separately to each time/material category, rather than multiplying overlapping reductions. Wizard Spell Scribing therefore supplies the same half-time factor and its better half-cost factor for its own qualifying copying; owning both gives neither quarter time nor a second material discount. Convert to minutes and round the final active time upward to a whole minute. For divisible mundane inputs retain exact quantities; for indivisible items round required remaining units upward; a listed aggregate gp expense rounds upward to the next cp. Separately identify rare/unique inputs before applying a discount to a mixed bill. No classification from absence: an unitemized ambiguous special-ink bill must be resolved by its source procedure before a discount is claimed. Level-up free additions remain free. Matrix preparation, reconstructing unknown text from memory, formula research and copying an ordinary craft formula are not spell/scroll copying. A usable scroll can be duplicated only under a separately authorized scroll-production procedure; the feat supplies no procedure or item effect.

FT84 source-follow-through selection (proposed; the following explicit interaction controls only this named composition):
FT84-Q01 / FT84-WRITTEN-RITUAL-01 — scoped selection for Ritual Caster learning and Spell Scribe.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: the actual Ritual Caster written-learning route is an authorized spell-copying procedure when the learner personally uses an already complete, legitimately accessible written version of the exact eligible ritual, can actually use its language/notation, and records the learned ritual in the learner's real usable ritual book. The written source must supply the complete instruction, not merely a title, unfinished notes or text whose missing content must be taught. This predicate is about how the real work is done; the presence of a tutor does not disqualify otherwise genuine written copying, and writing lecture notes does not convert teacher-led learning into copying.
For that written-copy work, an actually acquired Spell Scribe halves the ordinary eight-active-hours-per-rank learning requirement; take the strongest eligible time factor once, then apply Spell Scribe's final whole-minute upward rounding. A current rank-one ritual therefore requires 240 active minutes. Retain every completed 15-minute learning phase and its governing interruption/final-remainder rule. No reading, comprehension, recording, rank, tag, consent, facility, tool or source requirement disappears. Diligent Researcher, Craftsman, Quick Ritualist and Ritual Channeler do not reduce this learning transaction. No new starting ritual or physical book, Wizard spellbook entitlement, ordinary scroll-production permission, check, trade XP or automatic class acquisition is granted.
Teacher-led learning without the qualifying complete written source remains 480 active minutes per rank. A later lawful switch to written-copy work can affect only actually remaining unworked learning at a completed phase boundary; log the old and new basis and retain all actual time/materials. Do not retroactively relabel completed teaching or an interrupted uncredited segment as discounted copying. Only one route credits each actual minute. Wizard Spell Scribing keeps its own legal-found-Wizard-spell/spellbook predicate and its own bill; merely being a Wizard or having the same physical book does not substitute its class route for this feat route. When two reductions genuinely cover the same procedure and material category, take the strongest once, not their product.
NEW LIMITED BILL COMPLETION: before claiming a material reduction, record the real ten-gp-per-rank practice/writing bill as actual stock quantities and identified categories; it is not a new currency-only substitute for materials. Ordinary blank writing stock, ordinary nonrare ink and ordinary practice supplies are discountable only when their actual source/provider identifies them as such. Rare inks and unique or specifically required components remain full quantity; copying rights, instructor/facility services, reusable tools and the separate blank book are not made discountable by calling them consumables. There is no universal numeric split of the ten gp. A stated mixed bill must retain its undiscounted total and each actual lot's identity, availability and legal precision. Apply Spell Scribe's 3/4 mundane factor separately from time; preserve divisible quantities, ceil required indivisible units once, and ceil the final actual purchase once to copper. Known protected items remain unchanged.
An unitemized or ambiguous bill has no justified material discount. The otherwise legal learner may still use the qualifying half-time route and supply the complete genuine undiscounted materials/bill; missing classification does not ban copying or its independent time benefit. Missing actual required materials still prevents work. No guessed rarity classification, refund for supplies already used, duplication of the source, free rare ink or teaching-cost waiver follows. Real consumption, deterioration and fees are recorded as they occur; interruption loses only its actual phase credit and actual resources, never refills stock.

NEW feat learning route: with an actual complete legitimate formula/text or a willing qualified teacher who genuinely knows the exact ritual, spend8active hours per rank and10gp per rank of real practice/writing materials to record it in your actual usable ritual book. Study uses completed15-minute phases under the language/research clock; it is spell learning/copying, not ordinary research for Diligent Researcher’s discount. The present proposed tag set has only rank1entries, and future entries need their own exact review.

To cast a legitimately learned recorded ritual, use its actual book and all components, spend its ordinary casting time plus ten actual minutes of uninterrupted active casting, and meet its complete targets/action-trigger rules. This route cannot complete during an encounter; interruption ends the attempt with real time and committed consumables spent. NEW maintain concentration during the long casting procedure, ending incompatible prior concentration at commitment; at resolution continue only the resulting spell’s own concentration if any. Do not choose a Reaction-triggered spell and manufacture its trigger through slow preparation. Ordinary rankRPprice and price-only surcharge are0; an expressly printed consumedRPconversion or other independent cost still applies and needs an actual pool. No ordinary Dissonance generation or vent, no Refrain addition/reset or history alteration, and no resource recovery from merely completing the casting time; a spell’s explicitly bounded actual effect remains its own effect. This follows the intended ordinary ritual separation rather than creating an at-will strain reset. Actual Counterspell eligibility, one-attempt-per-pending-cast guards, components and range apply. Source-specific per-rest limits remain. Other pending ritual feats cannot reduce this time or multiply output until their own interactions are decided.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual Gnome heritage. NEW once per24 elapsed hours, spend10 uninterrupted minutes with actual usable tinkers tools and5gp of suitable owned mundane parts; commit the use and parts at construction start. On completion roll1d4 openly on the four complete profiles below; no choice, reroll, duplicate product or refund for an unwanted result. Place it in a reachable legal space or activate it with the profile's Action; moving/holding uses actual hands/object rules. At expiry/dismantling it becomes inert spent parts with no reusable credited crafting value; no purchased tool/supply/consumable is replenished. FT84 source-follow-through selection (proposed; the following explicit interaction controls only this named composition):
FT84-Q03 / FT84-CLOSED-CREATION-01 — Craftsman applies to actual authorized creation, not names or all fixed-duration work.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: personally leading an independently authorized closed feat process that makes/assembles a new usable physical body or prepared kit is eligible creation even when it is non-artisan, lacks a catalog recipe ID or prints a fixed base duration. Craftsman supplies only its half-active-time factor; it supplies no process, skill, formula, assistants, work opportunity, materials, use or output. Use the strongest genuinely applicable creation reduction once. An explicit source exclusion or distinct alteration/preparation/service category still controls. Keep actual physical minimum phases only where the source requires them; do not manufacture an advanced-recipe incorporation phase for every short feat process.
Contraption Crafter's ten minutes are the ordinary base for its real gadget construction. With actual personally leading Craftsman ownership the complete job is five uninterrupted active minutes, not ten with a final five-minute discount and not two-and-a-half from a second equivalent half. The whole adjusted job must be uninterrupted; phase logging, assistant handoff, pauses, rest or partially completed earlier attempts cannot satisfy it. Keep actual Gnome heritage, usable tinker's tools, the same five-gp suitable owned parts and the same once-per-24-elapsed-hours use committed at start. A new lawful construction still ends its old gadget at start. Interruption spends the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget, no completion roll, no refundable tail and no resumable partial product. Completion rolls the same one d4 openly, once; it grants no chosen profile, duplicate gadget, general proficiency, quality, recipe XP or parts recovery. The same one-hour gadget lifetime starts at actual completion, not at the undiscounted hypothetical finish. Transfer/deployment/activation/recharge rules are unchanged. The time benefit is prospective and cannot manufacture a mid-job feat acquisition opportunity; if a real change interrupts the required work, the ordinary failure consequence applies.
Trapsetter's independently authorized thirty-active-minute kit assembly is likewise eligible creation: fifteen active minutes with Craftsman. This includes only its actual prepared-kit assembly from the real source parts; it cannot manufacture an ordinary twenty-caltrop stock bag out of an arbitrary substitute or count buying/deploying one as new creation. Keep the one completion DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves-tools check, ordinary task degree/natural shifts collapsed to binary, actual parts, failure consumption and recoverable remaining metal/frame. No manufacturing quality/yield/XP or general recipe is added. NEW NARROW WORK-CREDIT COMPLETION for this otherwise unphased kit assembly: track actual active work in seconds against the adjusted required total; pauses do not by themselves erase already completed usable physical assembly work. A pause earns no credit, protection or rest entitlement. Preserve the actual partial body and committed stock under their ordinary custody, deterioration and loss rules; work that a genuine physical event destroys cannot remain credited. The unfinished kit has no function. Resume only the remaining actual work with the real usable/replacement parts; do not duplicate stock, credit or partial bodies. No completion roll occurs until the whole adjusted job is actually complete. Neither Contraption's uninterrupted-work/use forfeiture nor advanced manufacture's incorporation/stabilization is imported. A more-specific explicitly authorized phase/loss rule still controls.
Kit assembly does not spend or refresh Trapsetter's three source-specific quick-placement allowances, arm a trap, clear an old active slot, reset hard-denial history or reduce placement, arming, disarming, collection or trigger/Reaction costs. Those remain separately paid physical events.
Apply the same predicate to Bowyer's actual bounded mundane bow/arrow creation and Master Smithing's authorized weapon/armor creation: their actual creation work qualifies, with full bridge credentials, stock, DC, phases and waits. Combat Engineering's actual barricade creation also qualifies but its own half factor and Craftsman compare once (60 to30, not15). Master Smithing's expressly nondiscounted eight-hour temper and Combat Engineering's expressly fixed ten-minute kill-zone preparation remain unchanged. Separate encoding, repair, maintenance, harvesting, copying, ritual casting and rest remain outside Craftsman. Actual advanced recipe121 still keeps its own required included incorporation/phase/stock/assistant rules; the short feat processes do not rewrite them. Merely printing a fixed duration neither exempts genuine creation nor makes a noncreation activity eligible.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Require Engineering proficiency or the proposed mechanical Disable Device/thieves’-tools credential. NEW three closed prepared-kit options use genuine physical parts and no invented recipe/craft XP: snare (5gp reference,2lb cord/spring/anchor), caltrop field (the actual ordinary20-caltrop source bag, preserving its price/weight), and spring-loaded charge (25gp reference,3lb trigger body plus actual prepared combustible filling). Availability and assembly are real: obtain a genuinely prepared kit from an actual provider, or spend30active minutes with suitable mechanical tools and the same actual parts, DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves’-tools, using Core binary task outcome. Failure consumes time and expendable cord/filling, retaining only real recoverable frame/metal parts; no free complete kit. The new reference prices are complete kit references, not added again to their component prices. No ordinary Rune or Tinkering formula is silently renamed one of these three options.

Place one held/accessible prepared kit in a real stable unoccupied5-foot ground square within5feet. Normally this feat procedure takes an Action; once per Short Rest for each of the three types, you may use a Bonus Action instead, spending that type’s separate quick-placement allowance. NEW one armed trap of each type per setter; arming a replacement disarms the old one without refund or teleportation. It arms at your next original regular-turn start, or after six elapsed seconds outside initiative, preserving the same deadline across mode changes. SnapshotDC8+PB+INT modifier at placement. The first actual grounded creature entering from outside, including an ally, forced movement or teleport arrival, triggers once; an existing occupant, flying above it, or replayed movement is not another entry. The target makesDEXsave against the storedDC. On failure: snare givesStunned until the target’s next regular-turn end; charge deals2d6fire in that same event with no ongoing Burn; caltrop field uses the reviewed ordinary caltrop failure effect of1piercing, stopping remaining movement that turn and-10walkingSpeed until1HPhealing or an Action removes the caltrop. The caltrop slow is one shared same-area effect, not a new Slow condition, and moving at halfSpeed still avoids its save as under its actual item rule. Success avoids the trap’s feat effect. NEW these fields discharge after that first eligible trigger regardless of result; surviving actual metal/body can be recovered, but rearming requires a new prepared kit procedure/consumed expendables. A charge consumes its filling; this does not duplicate its frame. Placement speed does not shorten preparation or refill after transfer.

The exposed snare/charge assembly isAC15/5HP; caltrops retain their actual ordinary physical pieces. An Action with safe reach disarms your own accessible trap. Another creature that has detected it can spend an Action with actual appropriate tools onDCequal to storedDC using INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves’-tools; failure triggers it only if that actual manipulation enters its working trigger, not arbitrarily against a remote observer. Hidden placement requires actual concealment: record one real setter DEX/Stealth check opposed by the actual search/passive-perception procedure, without granting invisibility. Once visible, ordinary physical removal/destruction still follows actual reach/safety and object rules. A trap that is moved,Broken,covered or disconnected becomes disarmed and needs real rearming; reconstruction never duplicates stock or the type’s spent quick-placement use.

You have advantage on actual checks to spot hidden traps or tunnel evidence within30feet, not automatic sight through walls or knowledge that a tunnel exists. On a real trigger of any trap you personally placed, after its immediate effect resolves and if you are still capable of taking a Reaction and can perceive the triggering creature within30feet, you may spend that Reaction to move up to half your current applicable Speed. Pay ordinary terrain/mode costs from this distinct movement budget, respect speed0/restraints and actual paths. This movement provokes no opportunity attack from that triggering creature; other creatures’ normal opportunity attacks remain. You may use real cover or a real prepared kill-zone at the destination, but the feat creates neither. One trigger event permits at most one Reaction; copies, already discharged traps and additional targets of one blast are not new triggers.

Craftsman supplies only its half-active-time factor; it supplies no process, skill, formula, assistants, work opportunity, materials, use or output. Use the strongest genuinely applicable creation reduction once. An explicit source exclusion or distinct alteration/preparation/service category still controls. Keep actual physical minimum phases only where the source requires them; do not manufacture an advanced-recipe incorporation phase for every short feat process.
Contraption Crafter's ten minutes are the ordinary base for its real gadget construction. With actual personally leading Craftsman ownership the complete job is five uninterrupted active minutes, not ten with a final five-minute discount and not two-and-a-half from a second equivalent half. The whole adjusted job must be uninterrupted; phase logging, assistant handoff, pauses, rest or partially completed earlier attempts cannot satisfy it. Keep actual Gnome heritage, usable tinker's tools, the same five-gp suitable owned parts and the same once-per-24-elapsed-hours use committed at start. A new lawful construction still ends its old gadget at start. Interruption spends the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget, no completion roll, no refundable tail and no resumable partial product. Completion rolls the same one d4 openly, once; it grants no chosen profile, duplicate gadget, general proficiency, quality, recipe XP or parts recovery. The same one-hour gadget lifetime starts at actual completion, not at the undiscounted hypothetical finish. Transfer/deployment/activation/recharge rules are unchanged. The time benefit is prospective and cannot manufacture a mid-job feat acquisition opportunity; if a real change interrupts the required work, the ordinary failure consequence applies.
